errors.evidence: There are not two sets of stacked bars; both charts cover the same time period from 1991 to 2023. The structural description does not match the figure.

errors.text_span: Der zweite Satz, der die Jahre 2000 bis 2023 umfasst, besteht aus einem schwarzen Linienplot, der „Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt“ darstellt.
errors.evidence: The machine description inaccurately describes a separate set, whereas the black line is present in both charts representing 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt' and not tied to individual sets.
The machine description does not distinguish between gross and net public investments as shown in the two separate charts.
The description does not mention the negative range on the y-axis; it should include the range from -0.5 to 3.5.
